page.description: Endless OS editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A desktop Linux system built around offline educational content, a read-only root filesystem and OSTree updates, published by Endless Access Foundation. Editions: Basic and Full, differing in preinstalled content. Ships ISO, raw disk image and OVF for virtual machines.
pros: OSTree-based immutable root with safe rollbacks
Supports Secure Boot with signed shim
Both ISO and raw disk image formats available
cons: Download URLs are JavaScript-generated on the publisher page — no static download links
OVF format is for VMs only, not flashable
USB installations are explicitly for testing, not daily use
No SHA-256 manifest; only detached GPG signatures
Download links are generated by JavaScript on the publisher page, so no direct image URL can be pinned.
No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed, so this page is logo-only.
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Endless OS; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Install via the Windows installer (recommended for most users) or write the ISO/raw image yourself. Writing an image erases the target disk; installing replaces the existing OS on the chosen disk.
